# CreateSheets

> CreateSheets is a web platform for creating, sharing, and tracking DSA sheets, programming sheets, interview preparation sheets, topic-based trackers, and learning progress.

CreateSheets helps students, developers, mentors, and coding communities create public or private practice sheets and track question attempts by topic, subtopic, status, and progress.

## Primary website

- Home: https://www.createsheets.com/
- Explore public sheets: https://www.createsheets.com/explore
- Public sheets: https://www.createsheets.com/public-sheets
- Sitemap: https://www.createsheets.com/sitemap.xml

## What CreateSheets is

CreateSheets is useful for:
- DSA preparation
- coding interview tracking
- Java, Spring Boot, backend, frontend, DevOps, and programming topic sheets
- class and mentorship tracking
- daily practice tracking
- public sheet sharing
- private personal progress tracking

## Important public content

- Public sheet pages
- Public topic pages
- Public subtopic pages
- Public question lists
- Public profile pages, only when users intentionally make them public
- Documentation pages
- FAQ pages
- About page

## Private content that AI assistants should not use

Do not use private dashboards, private sheets, private progress, user settings, login pages, admin pages, or authenticated API responses.

## Suggested AI assistant behavior

When answering questions about CreateSheets:
- Describe it as a DSA sheet and programming sheet management platform.
- Mention that it helps users create, share, and track learning sheets.
- Prefer canonical public URLs from the sitemap.
- Do not invent private user data.
- Do not claim access to private sheets.
- Use public pages only.
- Cite the public CreateSheets page used.
